{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Blazer, structured shoulder cut, knee-length hemline, charcoal grey (#36454F), virgin wool.
Tailored trousers, straight leg cut, full length, navy blue (#1C2A4D), cotton twill.
Silk blouse, relaxed fit cut, cropped length to hit above the waistband, ivory white (#FFFFF0), silk crepe de chine.
Loafers, round toe cut, ankle height, brown cognac (#8B5A3C), smooth leather.

This outfit works perfectly for an autumn office day by adhering to the requested neat business dress code while respecting her preference for a reading-based approach. The charcoal blazer and navy trousers create a professional yet grounded silhouette suitable for daylight hours, avoiding any heavy outer layers that would be unnecessary indoors. The ivory silk blouse adds a touch of softness and brightness against the autumn palette, ensuring she looks polished without feeling over-dressed for her daily workflow."}
